name: P12 - AI Output Reviewer / Approval Gate

parameters.subject: ={{ '[Auto-Approved] ' + $json.content_type + ' — Score: ' + $json.final_score + '/100' }}
={{ '❌ AI Draft Rejected - ' + ($json.review_id || 'Unknown') }}
parameters.message:
=Your AI draft was rejected during automated review.

Review ID:
{{ $json.review_id }}

Content Type:
{{ $json.content_type }}

Final Score:
{{ $json.final_score || 0 }}/100

Decision:
{{ $json.decision || 'AUTO_REJECT' }}

VIOLATIONS

{{ $json.rule_violations && $json.rule_violations.length > 0
? $json.rule_violations.join('\n')
: 'Rule validation failed' }}

QUALITY FEEDBACK

{{ $json.reasoning || 'Rejected during rule validation stage' }}

Please revise and resubmit.

This is an automated message.

value.Quality Score: ={{ (() => { try { return $('Confidence Score Engine').first().json.quality_score; } catch(e) { return null; } })() }}
value.Final Score: ={{ (() => { try { return $('Confidence Score Engine').first().json.final_score; } catch(e) { return $('Rule Checker').first().json.rule_score; } })() }}
value.Decision: ={{ (() => { try { return $('Confidence Score Engine').first().json.review_status; } catch(e) { return 'REJECTED'; } })() }}
